chain.title: Run Aground On Purpose
chain.desc: Crafted from five boats and nothing else, it places the Supply Ship whose chest holds the Town Hall block and the build tool.

chain.title: Plant the Flag
chain.desc: Crafted from planks around a gold scepter build tool; placing it founds the colony and is the mod's root advancement step.

chain.title: Someone Has To Lift the Stones
chain.desc: Planks plus a wooden door and the build tool; hiring a builder here is what turns every later hut into a real building.

chain.title: The Endless To-Do List
chain.desc: Leather, sticks and the build tool make the clipboard that lists every open worker request in the colony.

chain.title: Read the Shortfall
chain.desc: Leather, sticks and the build tool; bound to a Builder's Hut it shows the exact materials that build is still missing.

chain.title: Shelves That Never Fill
chain.desc: Planks and iron nuggets; racks are the storage every hut uses instead of vanilla chests.

chain.title: A Roof For Somebody
chain.desc: Planks around a torch; the residence hut is what raises the colony's population cap.

chain.title: Word Gets Around
chain.desc: Planks around a barrel; the tavern draws new citizens and wandering visitors to the colony.

chain.title: The Forest Answers
chain.desc: A production-branch hut whose worker fells and replants trees to keep the builder supplied with wood.

chain.title: Down and Then Sideways
chain.desc: A production-branch hut; its miner digs a shaft and side tunnels, unlocking the mod's deep mine advancement.

chain.title: Break the Sod
chain.desc: A production-branch hut; the farmer works the scarecrow-marked fields assigned to it.

chain.title: Scarecrow Rights
chain.desc: The only hut craftable without the build tool: sticks, leather and a hay block or pumpkin mark a farmer's field.

chain.title: Nobody Works Hungry
chain.desc: A production-branch hut; the cook feeds every citizen, which the citizen_eat_food advancement tracks.

chain.title: Everything In One Place
chain.desc: Planks around any chest; the warehouse is the central stock the whole colony draws from.

chain.title: Legs of the Colony
chain.desc: Planks around leather or iron boots; couriers require the warehouse and haul goods between it and every workplace.

chain.title: Order From Afar
chain.desc: Planks, a chest and the build tool; the postbox lets you request warehouse items directly, and pairs with the stash.

chain.title: Planks By the Hundred
chain.desc: Planks around a wooden axe; the sawmill unlocks the whole crafting branch of huts and requires the courier first.

chain.title: Cut, Chisel, Repeat
chain.desc: A sawmill-gated crafting hut whose mason turns raw stone into the bricks and shaped blocks builds demand.

chain.title: Eyes on the Treeline
chain.desc: Planks around a bow; the guard tower is the root of the mod's entire military advancement branch.

chain.title: They Found You
chain.desc: Barbarians are raiders that assault the colony as it grows; every raider type drops the ancient tome.

chain.title: Standing Army
chain.desc: Planks around an iron block; the barracks is the fortified core that guard towers attach to.

chain.title: Man the Corners
chain.desc: The tower that slots into a barracks; filling every socket completes the all_barracks_towers advancement.

chain.title: Pupils and Patience
chain.desc: Planks around a book; students here study from books and paper and generate the research points the university spends.

chain.title: Unlock the Future
chain.desc: Planks around a book; the university opens the 311-node research tree covering civilian, combat, technology and unlockable branches.

notes: Item set = 232 ids from assets/minecolonies/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys in assets/*/lang/en_us.json; entity ids from entity.minecolonies.* (37 found). Every id above is set-membership verified. Build order was taken from the jar's own advancement tree in data/minecolonies/advancements/: minecolonies/root (supply_placed) -> place_townhall -> start_builder -> fulfill_request -> build_builder, which is also the parent of production/root; production/root -> {farmer, fisherman, lumberjack, miner, cook, library, warehouse} , warehouse -> deliveryman -> sawmill -> {blacksmith, crusher, sifter, smeltery, stonesmeltery, stonemason}, cook -> baker, farmer -> composter -> florist, library -> enchanter; military/root is guardtower -> {archery, combatacademy, barracks -> barrackstower -> all_barracks_towers}. Recipes were read from data/minecolonies/recipes/, and the raider drops from data/minecolonies/loot_tables/entities/ (ancienttome drops from all 18 raider types; chiefsword from chiefbarbarian, pharaoscepter and firearrow from pharao, iron_scimitar and the pirate gear from chiefpirate/drownedchiefpirate, spear from amazonspearman). WebSearch confirmed the supply chest contains the Town Hall block and build tool, and the warehouse+courier ordering. VERIFIED AS REQUESTED: minecolonies:supplychestdeployer, minecolonies:supplycampdeployer and minecolonies:resourcescroll all exist in the jar. DROPPED: the scan tool and the build tool are NOT minecolonies ids - every hut recipe in the jar keys on structurize:sceptergold, and the scan tool is structurize:scantool, so neither is set-membership verifiable against this jar; minecolonies:scan_analyzer does exist but its only jar reference is compatibility/itemnbtmatching.json, giving no acquisition source, so it was left out too. Also dropped: minecolonies:largequarry (zero references anywhere in the jar's data, unlike simplequarry and mediumquarry which have recipes). No dim: entries - the jar contains no minecolonies dimension. University research is expressed as the final chain step rather than as individual research nodes because researches are data ids, not item/entity ids.
